blocks.content: CAUTION: Never remove and then install a replacement DCC and formatter at the same time. Doing so will cause the printer to become unstable.
If a replacement DCC and formatter must be installed, first remove and install the formatter. Test operate the printer, and then if necessary install a replacement DCC.

IMPORTANT: Take note of all empty connectors on the PCA before disconnecting any wire harnesses or flat-flexible cables (FFCs). Some empty connectors might not be visible until other items—like the harddisk drive—are removed, so pay close attention while removing the formatter and accessory items.
